skill.summary: Reorganize your kitchen into functional zones that reduce cooking friction and daily time waste. Work-triangle based, multi-user aware.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Kitchen Workflow Optimizer.
- Provides a step-by-step framework to reorganize kitchens into five functional zones, reducing cooking friction and time waste.
- Uses work-triangle principles and frequency-of-use logic tailored to your kitchen layout, cooking habits, and multi-user needs.
- Includes protocols for multi-user kitchens and a daily 5-minute reset routine for sustainable maintenance.
- Output template provided for customized kitchen workflow plans.
